info.title: Every.org Universal API
info.description: Search nonprofits and create fundraisers with Every.org

get.description: Finds nonprofits in Every.org by cause.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: cause
parameters.description: Cause slug to browse.

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: Results per page. Maximum 100.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number to return.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of records to skip before returning results.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
